dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The dorsal-lateral surface features numerous interlocking, irregularly circular rings (annuli) with high-contrast, light-grey crenulated perimeters. These rings exhibit a sharp gradient transition from the bright, jagged outer edges to darker, charcoal-toned internal cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid high-intensity clusters. A singular, highly prominent, near-white circular blob is located in the upper-mid dorsal region. Smaller, less intense clusters are visible towards the anterior dorsal region, lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The prominent high-intensity white blob forms the apex of an obtuse triangle when connected to the centroids of two large, well-defined annuli situated posterolaterally. A series of four smaller annuli centroids form a curvilinear chain along the mid-lateral line.

other_distinctive_markers: The texture exhibits a reticulated, net-like topology where the light-colored perimeters of adjacent annuli intersect, creating a contiguous tessellated pattern across the majority of the visible dorsal-lateral surface.
